title: Meh
text: Meh. I ordered what seemed to be brown in the picture but got a gray color instead totally a bust i was in the process of moving so i had far more important  business than returning a bathroom set for my secondary bathroom so i just kept it. Quality wise it's not bad, it's okay it's just what you want for a lightly used bathroom.

product_metadata.title: Home Dynamix 3351-179 Bath Boutique Poly-Acrylic 15-Piece Bathroom Set, Taupe
features: Set Includes One 18.1" by 29.5" Bath Mat, One 18.1" by 18.1" Contour Mat, One 70" by 70" Shower Curtain, 12 Matching Hooks
description: Home Dynamix has established it's self as one of the top leaders in pioneering and marketing the most exciting, innovative and value based bath products. They started in the New York metropolitan area and shortly thereafter, expanded on this success into the national and international arenas. Their bath collections offer modern designs and colors at an exceptional cost. The Bath Boutique Collection includes a bath mat, contour mat, shower curtain and matching shower curtain rings. This collection provides everything you need for a well decorated bathroom.
